scope: NPU complete-model actual attention; all-rank raw/dependency audit and rank-zero retained-query independent FP64 formula replay

configuration.normalization: softmax denominator includes native sink logit; sink has zero value
configuration.cache: Actual native physical block tables and saved active pages; producer/consumer storage aliases checked

evidence.full_raw_location: Retained privately on the original native host; no raw arrays or connection details included

figure_aggregation: Each layer has12 layer-forward comparisons. Lines show max and median across those12 values; shaded min-to-max is their range. Each underlying comparison covers four correlated tail-query rows ×8 heads ×512 dimensions. No reweighting of repeated residuals in the1920-query CSV is performed.
limitations: Unsaved query rows are not numerically replayed.
Other-rank attention formulas are not numerically replayed; their retained raw bytes and dependency chains are audited.
Compressor, indexer and projection arithmetic are outside this attention formula replay.
No training, service, cross-backend accuracy or whole-task completion claim.
Metrics are descriptive residuals without acceptance thresholds.
FP64 formula replay does not simulate native accumulation order or rounding; residuals alone do not establish a kernel defect.
